wordTarget.en: Cover all three points in full sentences. Do not forget a closing.
wordTarget.tr: Üç maddenin hepsini karşıla; tam cümleler kur. Kapanışı unutma.
wordTarget.es: Cubre los tres puntos con oraciones completas. No olvides la despedida.

screen.prompt: Write an email to the community center. In your email, do the following: (1) Say what you were looking forward to in the workshop. (2) Explain what happened. (3) Ask what the center can do about the time you missed.
screen.scenario: You signed up for a Saturday photography workshop at your local community center. At the last minute the workshop was moved to a different room, but nobody told the participants. You waited in the original room and missed the first hour. To: workshops@riversidecenter.org · Subject: Missed part of Saturday's workshop
